title: The $9,120 Storage Unit Trap Nobody Talks About
hook: One in ten Americans is renting a storage unit right now — and sixty-five percent of them are paying more than the stuff inside is actually worth.
angle: Self-storage is America's fastest-growing real estate category but nobody frames it as a personal finance drain — most people call it temporary, then keep paying for 4+ years
audience: Homeowners, renters, and anyone who has or has considered a storage unit as a 'quick fix' for clutter
key_numbers: $39.5 billion spent on self-storage annually in the US — more than the entire US film industry
Average renter keeps a unit for 4+ years = $9,120 total
65% of renters say the contents are worth less than the rent they've already paid
